# {{ site.service_name }}

> {{ site.description }}

{{ site.service_name }} is a GitHub App that decides when to deploy and creates
deployments through the GitHub Deployments API. Your own workflow (for example
GitHub Actions running Helm, kubectl or a GitOps commit) picks up the
`deployment` event and does the actual deploy. Behaviour is configured per
repository in `.github/deploy.yml`.

- Hosted service: {{ site.deliverybot_url }} (free)
- Install the GitHub App: {{ site.install_url }}
- Source code (MIT licensed, self-hostable): {{ site.source_url }}
- Issues and support: {{ site.community_url }} or {{ site.support_email }}
